title: All-in-One Multi-Industry Edition • World-Class 3D Header Capsule Festival Animation Update
highlights: World-Class Top-Bar Placement (Zero Vertical Space Waste): Festival & Birthday 3D animation now runs seamlessly inside the Top Bar right between the end of 'Dashboard' and the start of the 'Search' bar with a soft edge-fade glass capsule design.

True 3D Sculpted 60-FPS Motion Scenes: Upgraded Pongal (3D radial-shaded terracotta pots, curved sugarcanes, 3D muscular Kangayam bullocks with humps & farmer ploughing), Christmas (3D glossy curved sleigh, Santa & 3 galloping 3D reindeer), Ayudha Pooja (3D Mango-leaf & multi-petal Marigold garland + sculpted 3D metallic brass Kuthuvilakku lamps), Deepavali, Ramzan, Vinayagar Chaturthi, National Days, and Owner Birthday.

Smart 2-Day Pre-Festival Top Strip, 3-Day Pongal Celebration & Click-to-View Greeting Card: Starts 2 days before Diwali, Pongal, Christmas, and Ramzan; clicking the 3D capsule re-opens the Festival Greeting Card anytime.
Plan-Specific VIP License Activation Celebration & First-Install Shop Owner Birthday Collection.
3-Tier Subscription Plans: 1 Year (₹1,500), 3 Years Offer (₹3,000), and Lifetime + Android App Combo (₹9,000).
fixes: Moved festival animation strip into the unused space of AppTopBar between the page title and search bar so the billing workspace is never pushed down.
Replaced flat rectangular shapes in Pongal, Christmas, and Ayudha Pooja animations with true 3D radial/linear-shaded sculpted vector graphics and ground drop-shadows.
Prevented Free Plan monthly quota reset when deleting Invoices, Quotations, Job Sheets, or Products.
